lines.t: Lost in the static of my old ways
Then Your voice breaks through the haze
Thunder calling through a midnight storm
You said, “Return, My child, be reborn”
Every star You set in place, I see Your design
Even in my wandering, You call me “Mine”
You’re my melody, You’re my flame in the shadow
Your words cut deeper than the sorrow
Every road I take You make brand new
Your trumpet called, and I ran to You
You’re the Way, the Truth, the breakthrough
In a world so cold, You warm my soul
Pull me closer, make my spirit whole
Your words are fire in my chest
Your mercy’s heartbeat never rests
I searched the skies, I searched the ground
But only in Your voice was I found
You’re my melody, You’re my flame in the shadow
Your words cut deeper than the sorrow
Every road I take You make brand new
Your trumpet called, and I ran to You
You’re the Way, the Truth, the breakthrough
Take me higher, Lord, into Your light
Wash my sins in the edge of night
Your love’s the trap that caught my fall
Now I’m reigning with You through it all
You’re my melody, You’re my flame in the shadow
Your words cut deeper than the sorrow
Every road I take You make brand new
Your trumpet called, and I ran to You
You’re the Way, the Truth, the breakthrough
